`ezbookkeeping_feidee_*_sample.xls` are the tiny synthetic test workbooks from
[mayswind/ezbookkeeping](https://github.com/mayswind/ezbookkeeping) (`testdata/feidee_mymoney_test_file.xls`,
`testdata/feidee_mymoney_legacy_test_file.xls`), MIT licensed (see EZBOOKKEEPING_LICENSE). They contain only
"Test Account"/"Test Category" placeholder data and are used to check that real Suishouji web `.xls` exports
(new per-sheet layout and legacy layout) are read correctly.
